problem_text: Planet A has a mass (M) of 6000 nanograms and a radius of 100 meters, and its moon has a mass (m) of 2.0 x 10$^{22}$ kg. The moon revolves around the planet in an elliptical path and the closest distance between the center of these two bodies (d) is 3.0 x 10$^9$ meters. Both of these bodies are spherically symmetric. Calculate the gravitational force between these two bodies on each other at this location.
